instruction: Turn left from the place you are standing and move forward, slightly turn to your right and move a bit forward, turn right, you can find an opening, move towards the opening, slightly turn to your right and move forward towards the portrait which is infront of you, slightly turn to your left and move a bit forward, slightly turn to your left and move forward, where to the left you can find a mirror and to the right you can find an opened door, turn right and move towards the opened door, now you are at the entrance of the house, move a bit forward, now you are out of the house, that would be your end point.
